notes.title: Graphics Update!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,

First, we'd like to thank you for your patience. We're still working hard on the game to give you the best possible experience.

In the meantime, we'd like to present to you a long-awaited graphic update.
We've listened to your feedback and improved the game's graphics while staying true to our basic intentions.
You can play the demo now and see the changes for yourself.
We hope you will like this update, and if you do, please leave a review on Steam to let us know![/p][p]Orionis Productions[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44020174/227122b3b0780dfd4651d24ed4f403c15e3ae629.png"][/img][/p]
